checked.why: openingHindrance answers 0 unless the victim's row has a post (watch-gm.mjs:42-47); a post is written only by startWatches at drpgEclipseChanged true (:97-113) and endWatches drops every row at drpgEclipseChanged false (:138-153, :156-161). That hook is fired from the clock's sync row (sync.mjs:451, SYNC.clock and SYNC.eclipse rows) once advanceTimeOfDay writes eclipse: false (eclipse.mjs:474-477). judgePendingMurders, which calls openMurder for every parked declaration, runs LAST, after the clock has moved (eclipse.mjs:520-529, :879-893), and rollOpening reads openingHindrance only then (murder-rules.mjs:4426-4440); the GM's draw reads it again at the press (roll-draw.mjs:2240-2248). E74-T10 writes the row by hand with a post at noon and calls openMurder directly (tests-tier2.mjs, the E74-T10 body), so it cannot see the order. The promise in the notes is general (v1.2.111.md:102-104 'whoever opens a murder on the watcher'), and the stage's own DA44 row says the same (docs/dev/e74/STATUS.md:17). Not run.
